_comment: The Axis Sprint pilot form. One list, read by site-src/build_site.py to draw the page and by server.js to check what is sent, so the two cannot drift apart. Changing an option here changes both: rebuild the site and redeploy together.

fields.name: startup_name
fields.label: Startup name

fields.name: full_name
fields.label: Your full name

fields.name: email
fields.label: Your email

fields.name: is_founder
fields.label: Are you a founder of the startup?

sections.title: Pilot contact
sections.intro: The person we work with day to day during the pilot. This can be you.

fields.name: pilot_contact_name
fields.label: Name

fields.name: pilot_contact_email
fields.label: Email

fields.name: pilot_contact_phone
fields.label: Phone (optional)

fields.name: security_lead_status
fields.label: Does someone look after security at your startup?
options: Yes, a dedicated person or team
Yes, a founder or engineer alongside other work

fields.name: security_lead_name
fields.label: Security lead's name
fields.hint: Leave blank only if you answered Not yet.

fields.name: security_lead_email
fields.label: Security lead's email
fields.hint: Leave blank only if you answered Not yet.

sections.title: Your security setup
sections.intro: Rough answers are fine. They help us plan what Hydra would read during the pilot.

fields.name: hosting
fields.label: Where does your product run? Tick all that apply.

fields.name: sign_in
fields.label: How does your team sign in to work tools? Tick all that apply.

fields.name: tools
fields.label: Which security tools do you use today? Tick all that apply.

fields.name: tools_other
fields.label: Other security tools (optional)

fields.name: alerts_central
fields.label: Do you collect security alerts and logs in one place?

fields.name: alert_volume
fields.label: About how many security alerts do you get a day?
options: None, or we do not know

fields.name: alert_handling
fields.label: Who reads those alerts today?
options: Developers or IT, when they have time

fields.name: coverage
fields.label: About how many servers, laptops and cloud accounts would the pilot cover?

fields.name: incidents
fields.label: Have you had a security incident in the last 12 months?

fields.name: goals
fields.label: What do you most want Hydra to help with? Tick all that apply.
options: Read alerts we do not have time for
Catch attacks we might be missing
Show customers, investors or auditors that we monitor security

fields.name: success
fields.label: What would make the pilot worth it for you?

fields.name: start_when
fields.label: When could you start?

fields.name: weekly_time
fields.label: How much time can your team give the pilot each week?

fields.name: feedback_calls
fields.label: Can someone join a short feedback call every two weeks?

fields.name: naming
fields.label: Once the pilot ends, may we say your startup took part?

fields.name: notes
fields.label: Anything else we should know? (optional)
